test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ₹7,000 becomes ₹7,567 in 2 years at simple interest at a certain rate percentage. Find the principal amount (in ₹) that will become ₹24,050 in 5 years at the same rate of interest.
solution:
**Given:**

Amount (A₁) = ₹7,567

Principal (P₁) = ₹7,000

Time (T₁) = 2 years

Amount (A₂) = ₹24,050

Time (T₂) = 5 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A - P

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

SI₁ = 7567 - 7000 = ₹567

Using SI formula: 567 = (7000 × R × 2) ÷ 100
